minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  March 14, 2019

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was held on Thursday, March 14, 2019,
at 2:11 pm in the City Council Chambers, 9th Floor.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LACO Fire Department
  Lt. David Salcedo, Police Department
  Eddy Ikemefuna, Planning & Building Department

  Staff Present:  Peggy L. Velasquez, Finance Department
  Serena Martinez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee,
provided the item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License
Committee.
Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the
Permits & License Committee on any item on the Agenda.
Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Item #1:  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the business license
  request for Edith Tatiana; dba: Tayana’s Travel and Tours to operate as a
  travel agent at 10017 Inglewood Ave., subject to payment of annual
  business license and tax fees; Los Angeles County Fire Department field
  inspection; maintain current and valid State of California Department of
  Justice, Attorney General Office, Seller of Travel license; office use only;
  establish a business client trust account for each customer and deposit
  100% of all customer funds into said account up until conclusion of the
  business transaction; random inspections during regular business hours by
  any Peace Officer, Code Enforcement Officer or California Department of
  Consumer Affairs employee to enforce businesses adhere to the
  regulations set forth by the City of Inglewood and for Community Public
  Health & Safety; adhere to all IMC rules and regulations, including noise
  and signage, local, state, and federal laws. Motion carried unanimously.
  (Activity No. 00273845)

Item #2:  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the business license
  request for Ericka Chancellor; dba: Sweet Hair Studios to operate a hair
  salon at 314 E. Hillcrest Blvd., subject to payment of annual business
  license and tax; Los Angeles County Fire Department field inspection;
  business owner must possess and maintain a valid and current State Board
  of Barbering & Cosmetology, Establishment License; submit copy of
  establishment license to the Finance department; booth renters and/or
  independent contractors operating within the establishment must possess
  applicable licenses from the State Board of Barbering and Cosmetology,
  register and file business taxes with the City; parties and/or events are not
  permitted inside or outside the location; loitering and consumption of

  alcoholic beverages is not permitted on the premises; massage therapy of
  any part of the body is not permitted; disrobing is not permitted, patrons
  must remain fully clothed while receiving salon services; adhere to all
  applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise
  and signage. Motion carried unanimously. (Activity No. 00273886)

Item #3:  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the tobacco retailer
  license request for Juan Vega; dba: Mi Mercadito, Inc., to operate as a
  tobacco retailer at 10500 S. Prairie Ave., subject to sales of single cigarettes
  is strictly prohibited; sales of tobacco, hookah, vapor and e-cigarette
  products to minors, under age 21 is strictly prohibited; persons purchasing
  tobacco or any related tobacco products shall have valid identification on
  their person at all times to enforce laws restricting underage access to
  tobacco use, including hookah products;  “NO LOITERING,” “NO
  TRESSPASSING,” and “NO PANHANDLING” signage must be posted
  outside of the business; sales of marijuana and cannabis products,
  narcotics and narcotics paraphernalia, i.e., any type of pipe used to ingest
  other narcotics such as base “crack” cocaine, methamphetamine, including
  glass cylindrical tube and bubble shaped pipes used to smoke and/or
  ingest narcotics; sales of Tobacco pipes is permitted; sales or display of
  any type of weapons, i.e., clubs, swords, knives, pepper spray, Taser/Stun
  guns is strictly prohibited; Tobacco Retailer business owners and/or new
  applicants or their designees is subject to random Permits & Licensing
  establishment inspections at any time of the day or night by any Police and
  Code Enforcement officers; purpose of random inspections is to enforce
  business establishments adhere to the regulations set forth by the City of
  Inglewood and for Community Public Health & Safety; parties, social events
  or gatherings of any type is strictly prohibited; music boxes, live
  bands/music, disc jockeys (DJ’s), etc., is strictly prohibited; business
  owner(s) is required to operate within normal business hours; adhere to all
  applicable IMC rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion
  carried unanimously. (Activity No. 00273791)

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 2:19 p.m.

  Respectfully submitted,
  Peggy L. Velasquez, Recording Secretary
